note: TALKING-HEAD worked example (docs/EVALS.md, skills/vawe-type-talking-head/SKILL.md). No real voiceover exists for this example: the circle at top is the FACE-SAFE PLACEHOLDER, standing in for a real presenter shot, and the on-screen lines are a short hand-timed script (the `voWords`/`make vo-captions` path this skill names is for a real VO track). _why.craft-unvisited: same fixture: it exists to stay small and pass validate/liveness, not to carry a full craft pass
